post.text:
This guy literally hacked Polymarket with a hair dryer 💀

Happened in Paris.

On Polymarket, temperature bets were settled using a single sensor near Charles de Gaulle Airport.

He figured out the exact location, showed up in person, and placed a bet on an “impossible” outcome https://t.co/ykzOJ13Uik
post.author_description: tracking ecosystems | stacking bags | farming DeFi | studying charts

description.description: A person is holding a black hair dryer branded with the Polymarket logo and blowing air towards a digital kiosk in an airport terminal. The kiosk display shows a thermometer icon, a temperature of 24°C and 75°F, an airplane icon, and text indicating 'Terminal A Gate 3'. In the background, airport directional signs point toward Gates 1-8 and Terminal B, with blurred passengers in a seating area.
description.ocrText: Gates 1-8 Terminal B Polymarket 24°C 75°F Terminal A Gate 3
